_meta.scenario: Driver started the trip slightly earlier than scheduled (e.g., traffic cleared early, customer was ready). The driver_admin provides the actual start time to ensure accurate trip records and correct overage calculations for local/outstation trips.
_meta.note: start_datetime must be within the allowed time window: ±0 min for local/outstation, ±60 min for airport trips.
